{"script":"file line_count_workspace/working.txt
dos2unix line_count_workspace/working.txt
echo "Normalized line endings using dos2unix" >> line_count_workspace/working_info.txt
# Trim trailing empty lines
orig_lines=$(wc -l < line_count_workspace/working.txt)
sed -i -e :a -e '/^\n*$/{$d;N;ba' -e '}' line_count_workspace/working.txt
new_lines=$(wc -l < line_count_workspace/working.txt)
removed=$((orig_lines - new_lines))
echo "Removed $removed trailing empty lines" >> line_count_workspace/working_info.txt"}
